topic.title: Hangman Step 1
topic.description: First step of building Hangman: randomly choose a word and check if a single guessed letter is in the word. Introduces the in operator with strings.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using random.choice on a word list and the in operator to test membership.
learningNotes.challenges: None — this step focuses on a single guess check.
